entities.summary: Ioseb Grishashvili was a pen name of Ioseb Mamulishvili was a noted poet and historian from Georgia. A history museum in Tbilisi, his birth- and death place is named for him. Composer Tamara Antonovna Shaverzashvili used his text for her song “Regret.”
